csv_scope_of_work: The District desires to design and construct a new performance/auditorium facility on the Osborn Middle School grounds. The project must be designed to meet all regulatory requirements including building codes and Osborn School District design guidelines. Involvement of the community, the District s site council, district departments, and the school s administration will be an integral part of the design process. Options shall be presented to the stakeholders for consideration. The project will utilize Construction Manager at Risk delivery method.
